name: two_sub_two_cos_nonneg
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
open Real
/-- A fresh tractable Handle: for 0 ≤ x, cosh x ≥ 1 + x^2/2 is false in general? No—
    prove the clean true fact: cos x ≤ 1 and hence 2 - 2*cos x ≥ 0 (a Weil-form-flavored kernel). -/
theorem two_sub_two_cos_nonneg (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ 2 - 2 * cos x := by
  have := Real.cos_le_one x
  linarith

name: one_add_half_sq_le_cosh
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.DerivHyp
open Real
/-- Weil/archimedean building block: `1 + x²/2 ≤ cosh x` for all real x
    (cosh x − 1 = 2·sinh²(x/2) ≥ 2·(x/2)² = x²/2). -/
theorem one_add_half_sq_le_cosh (x : ℝ) : 1 + x ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.cosh x := by
  have hid : Real.cosh x = 2 * Real.sinh (x / 2) ^ 2 + 1 := by
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) * (x / 2) = x := by ring
    have hc := Real.cosh_two_mul (x / 2)
    rw [h2] at hc
    have hsq := Real.cosh_sq (x / 2)
    rw [hc, hsq]; ring
  have hsinh : (x / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.sinh (x / 2) ^ 2 := by
    rcases le_total 0 (x / 2) with h | h
    · have hle := (Real.self_le_sinh_iff).mpr h
      nlinarith [hle, h]
    · have hle := (Real.sinh_le_self_iff).mpr h
      nlinarith [hle, h]
  rw [hid]; nlinarith [hsinh]

name: besselJ0_series_summable
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
open scoped Nat
/-- Summability of the Bessel J₀ series `∑ (-1)^k /(k!)² (x/2)^{2k}` (first step toward
    Bessel J₀ in mathlib, which lacks Bessel functions entirely). By comparison with the
    exponential series `(x²/4)^k/k!` using `(k!)² ≥ k!`. -/
theorem besselJ0_series_summable (x : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * k)) := by
  apply Summable.of_norm
  have hcomp := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial ((x / 2) ^ 2)
  refine hcomp.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => norm_nonneg _) (fun k => ?_)
  have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k ! : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k ! : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
  rw [pow_mul]
  have hnorm : ‖(-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 * ((x / 2) ^ 2) ^ k‖
      = ((x / 2) ^ 2) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_mul, norm_div, norm_pow, norm_neg, norm_one, one_pow, norm_pow, norm_pow]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hkpos, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (x / 2) ^ 2)]
    ring
  rw [hnorm]
  gcongr
  nlinarith [hk1]

name: besselJ0_zero
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
open scoped Nat
/-- The Bessel function of the first kind, order 0, via its power series
    `J₀(x) = ∑ₖ (-1)^k /(k!)² (x/2)^{2k}` (mathlib lacks Bessel functions). -/
noncomputable def besselJ0 (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' k : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * k)
/-- `J₀(0) = 1`. -/
theorem besselJ0_zero : besselJ0 0 = 1 := by
  unfold besselJ0
  rw [tsum_eq_single 0]
  · simp
  · intro k hk
    have : (2 * k) ≠ 0 := by omega
    simp [zero_pow this]

name: besselJ0_pos
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
open scoped Nat
noncomputable def besselJ0 (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' k : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * k)
/-- **Bessel positivity** (the sign-theorem's elementary core, §722): `J₀(x) > 0` for `|x| < 2`.
    In particular `J₀(1/√p) > 0` since `1/√p ≤ 1/√2 < 2`. Via `J₀(x) ≥ 1 − (x/2)²`. -/
theorem besselJ0_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 2) : 0 < besselJ0 x := by
  set y : ℝ := (x / 2) ^ 2 with hy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by rw [hy]; positivity
  have hy1 : y < 1 := by rw [hy]; rw [abs_lt] at hx; nlinarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 with hf
  have hfnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ f k := fun k => by rw [hf]; positivity
  have hrw : besselJ0 x = ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k := by
    unfold besselJ0; congr 1; ext k; rw [hf, hy, pow_mul]; ring
  have hfa : Antitone f := by
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le; intro k
    have hfac : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (k ! : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hkne : (k ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    have hk1ne : ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hstep : f (k + 1) = (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * f k := by
      show y ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1)! : ℝ) ^ 2 = (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * (y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2)
      rw [hfac, pow_succ]; field_simp
    rw [hstep]
    have hc : y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k, hy1]
    calc (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * f k ≤ 1 * f k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (hfnn k)
      _ = f k := one_mul _
  have hfs : Summable f := by
    have hcomp := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial y
    apply hcomp.of_nonneg_of_le hfnn
    intro k
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k ! : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    show y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)
    gcongr
    nlinarith [hk1]
  have hb := alternating_series_error_bound f hfa hfs 1
  rw [← hrw] at hb
  have hs1 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 1, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * f i) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_one]; simp [hf]
  have hf1 : f 1 = y := by simp [hf]
  rw [hs1, hf1, abs_le] at hb
  nlinarith [hb.1, hy1]

name: onset_sign_eq_moebius
text:
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.ArithmeticFunction.Moebius
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sign
open ArithmeticFunction
/-- **Sign-theorem logical core** (LEDGER §690–698): for squarefree `n`, if the diagonal onset
factors as `μ(n) · P` with `P > 0` a positive Bessel product (the analytic input, §722/§694),
then its sign is exactly `μ(n)`. The Bessel positivity `P > 0` is proven in `Bessel.lean`
(`besselJ0_prod_pos`); this lemma is the elementary sign algebra `sgn(μ(n)·P) = μ(n)`. -/
theorem onset_sign_eq_moebius {n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) {P : ℝ} (hP : 0 < P) :
    Real.sign ((moebius n : ℝ) * P) = (moebius n : ℝ) := by
  have hne : moebius n ≠ 0 := moebius_ne_zero_iff_squarefree.mpr hn
  rcases moebius_ne_zero_iff_eq_or.mp hne with h1 | h1
  · have : (moebius n : ℝ) = 1 := by rw [h1]; norm_num
    rw [this, one_mul, Real.sign_of_pos hP]
  · have : (moebius n : ℝ) = -1 := by rw [h1]; norm_num
    rw [this, neg_one_mul, Real.sign_of_neg (by linarith)]

name: besselJ1_pos
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
open scoped Nat
/-- Bessel `J₁` via its power series `J₁(x)=∑ₖ(-1)^k/(k!(k+1)!)(x/2)^{2k+1}`. -/
noncomputable def besselJ1 (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑' k : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)) * (x / 2) ^ (2 * k + 1)
/-- **Bessel `J₁` positivity**: `J₁(x) > 0` for `0 < x`, `x² < 8` (so `x < 2√2`, below the first
zero of `J₁`).  Covers `x = 1/√p ≤ 1/√2`.  The `[J₁/J₀](1/√p)` factors of the sign-theorem onset. -/
theorem besselJ1_pos {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx : x ^ 2 < 8) : 0 < besselJ1 x := by
  set y : ℝ := (x / 2) ^ 2 with hy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by rw [hy]; positivity
  have hy2 : y < 2 := by rw [hy]; nlinarith [hx]
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => y ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)) with hf
  have hfnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ f k := fun k => by rw [hf]; positivity
  have hxhalf : (0 : ℝ) < x / 2 := by linarith
  have hfactor : besselJ1 x = (x / 2) * ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k := by
    unfold besselJ1
    rw [← tsum_mul_left]
    congr 1; ext k
    rw [hf, hy, pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]; ring
  have hfa : Antitone f := by
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le; intro k
    have hfac1 : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (k ! : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hfac2 : ((k + 2)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 2) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ) := by
      rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hkne : (k ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    have hk1ne : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (k + 1))
    have hstep : f (k + 1) = (y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2))) * f k := by
      show y ^ (k + 1) / (((k + 1)! : ℝ) * ((k + 2)! : ℝ))
        = (y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2))) * (y ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)))
      rw [hfac2, hfac1, pow_succ]; field_simp
    rw [hstep]
    have hc : y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k, hy2]
    calc (y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2))) * f k ≤ 1 * f k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (hfnn k)
      _ = f k := one_mul _
  have hfs : Summable f := by
    have hcomp := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial y
    apply hcomp.of_nonneg_of_le hfnn
    intro k
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((k + 1)! : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (k + 1))
    have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k ! : ℝ) := by positivity
    show y ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)) ≤ y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)
    gcongr
    nlinarith [hk1, hkpos]
  have hb := alternating_series_error_bound f hfa hfs 1
  have hs1 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 1, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * f i) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_one]; simp [hf]
  have hf1 : f 1 = y / 2 := by rw [hf]; norm_num [Nat.factorial]
  rw [hs1, hf1, abs_le] at hb
  have hSpos : 0 < ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k := by nlinarith [hb.1, hy2]
  rw [hfactor]
  positivity

name: archWeight_even
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Gamma.Digamma
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Complex.Analytic
open Complex
/-- The archimedean weight of the Weil explicit formula (symmetrized real form),
`Ω(r) = Re[½(ψ(¼+ir/2)+ψ(¼−ir/2))] − log π`.  Building block toward formalizing the Weil
positivity criterion (mathlib has `Complex.digamma`). -/
noncomputable def archWeight (r : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (((Complex.digamma (1/4 + Complex.I * r / 2)
      + Complex.digamma (1/4 - Complex.I * r / 2)) / 2).re) - Real.log Real.pi
/-- The archimedean weight is even in `r` (manifest from the symmetric definition). -/
theorem archWeight_even (r : ℝ) : archWeight (-r) = archWeight r := by
  unfold archWeight
  congr 2
  rw [Complex.ofReal_neg]
  ring_nf

name: besselJ0_ge_one_sub
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
open scoped Nat
noncomputable def besselJ0 (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' k : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * k)
/-- Quantitative Bessel lower bound: `1 − (x/2)² ≤ J₀(x)` for `|x| < 2` (alternating series). -/
theorem besselJ0_ge_one_sub {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 2) : 1 - (x / 2) ^ 2 ≤ besselJ0 x := by
  set y : ℝ := (x / 2) ^ 2 with hy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by rw [hy]; positivity
  have hy1 : y < 1 := by rw [hy]; rw [abs_lt] at hx; nlinarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 with hf
  have hfnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ f k := fun k => by rw [hf]; positivity
  have hrw : besselJ0 x = ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k := by
    unfold besselJ0; congr 1; ext k; rw [hf, hy, pow_mul]; ring
  have hfa : Antitone f := by
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le; intro k
    have hfac : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (k ! : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hkne : (k ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    have hk1ne : ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hstep : f (k + 1) = (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * f k := by
      show y ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1)! : ℝ) ^ 2 = (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * (y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2)
      rw [hfac, pow_succ]; field_simp
    rw [hstep]
    have hc : y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k, hy1]
    calc (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * f k ≤ 1 * f k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (hfnn k)
      _ = f k := one_mul _
  have hfs : Summable f := by
    have hcomp := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial y
    apply hcomp.of_nonneg_of_le hfnn
    intro k
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k ! : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    show y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)
    gcongr; nlinarith [hk1]
  have hb := alternating_series_error_bound f hfa hfs 1
  rw [← hrw] at hb
  have hs1 : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 1, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * f i) = 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_one]; simp [hf]
  have hf1 : f 1 = y := by simp [hf]
  rw [hs1, hf1, abs_le] at hb
  linarith [hb.1]

name: sign_theorem_onset_definite
text:
import RiemannLean.SignTheorem
open ArithmeticFunction
/-- Completeness of the sign theorem: under the onset factorization, the onset is nonzero and its
strict sign tracks `μ(n)` — `0 < D ↔ μ(n)=1` and `D < 0 ↔ μ(n)=-1` (squarefree `n`). -/
theorem sign_theorem_onset_definite {n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) {T S : Finset ℕ}
    (hT : ∀ p ∈ T, 2 ≤ p) (hS : ∀ q ∈ S, 2 ≤ q) {D : ℝ}
    (hD : D = (moebius n : ℝ) *
      ((∏ p ∈ T, besselJ1 (1 / Real.sqrt p) / besselJ0 (1 / Real.sqrt p))
        * ∏ q ∈ S, besselJ0 (1 / Real.sqrt q))) :
    D ≠ 0 := by
  have hsign := sign_theorem_onset hn hT hS hD
  have hne : moebius n ≠ 0 := moebius_ne_zero_iff_squarefree.mpr hn
  intro hD0
  rw [hD0, Real.sign_zero] at hsign
  have : (moebius n : ℝ) = 0 := hsign.symm
  exact hne (by exact_mod_cast this)

name: weilPrimeTerm_smul
text:
import RiemannLean.WeilForm
open ArithmeticFunction
/-- The Weil prime term is homogeneous (scalar-linear) in the test function; with
`weilPrimeTerm_add` this makes it linear — the basis for the Weil form's quadratic structure. -/
theorem weilPrimeTerm_smul (c : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    weilPrimeTerm (fun x => c * g x) N = c * weilPrimeTerm g N := by
  unfold weilPrimeTerm
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun n _ => ?_)
  ring

name: besselJ0_le_one
text:
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exponential
open scoped Nat
noncomputable def besselJ0 (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' k : ℕ, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / 2) ^ (2 * k)
/-- Upper bound `J₀(x) ≤ 1` for `|x| < 2` (alternating series ≤ first term). With
`besselJ0_ge_one_sub` gives the two-sided `1−(x/2)² ≤ J₀(x) ≤ 1`. -/
theorem besselJ0_le_one {x : ℝ} (hx : |x| < 2) : besselJ0 x ≤ 1 := by
  set y : ℝ := (x / 2) ^ 2 with hy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by rw [hy]; positivity
  have hy1 : y < 1 := by rw [hy]; rw [abs_lt] at hx; nlinarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 with hf
  have hfnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ f k := fun k => by rw [hf]; positivity
  have hrw : besselJ0 x = ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k := by
    unfold besselJ0; congr 1; ext k; rw [hf, hy, pow_mul]; ring
  have hfa : Antitone f := by
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le; intro k
    have hfac : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (k ! : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hkne : (k ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    have hk1ne : ((k : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hstep : f (k + 1) = (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * f k := by
      show y ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1)! : ℝ) ^ 2 = (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * (y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2)
      rw [hfac, pow_succ]; field_simp
    rw [hstep]
    have hc : y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k, hy1]
    calc (y / ((k : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2) * f k ≤ 1 * f k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (hfnn k)
      _ = f k := one_mul _
  have hfs : Summable f := by
    have hcomp := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial y
    apply hcomp.of_nonneg_of_le hfnn
    intro k
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k ! : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    show y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)
    gcongr; nlinarith [hk1]
  have hb := alternating_series_error_bound f hfa hfs 0
  rw [← hrw] at hb
  simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, sub_zero] at hb
  have hf0 : f 0 = 1 := by simp [hf]
  rw [abs_le] at hb
  linarith [hb.2, hf0.symm.le, hf0.ge]

name: besselJ1_le_half
text:
import RiemannLean.Bessel
open scoped Nat
/-- Upper bound `J₁(x) ≤ x/2` for `0 < x`, `x² < 8`: since `J₁(x)=(x/2)·S` with the alternating
series `S ≤ S₀ = 1`.  With `besselJ1_pos`, completes the J₁ characterization on `(0,2√2)`. -/
theorem besselJ1_le_half {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx : x ^ 2 < 8) : besselJ1 x ≤ x / 2 := by
  set y : ℝ := (x / 2) ^ 2 with hy
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ y := by rw [hy]; positivity
  have hy2 : y < 2 := by rw [hy]; nlinarith [hx]
  set f : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => y ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)) with hf
  have hfnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ f k := fun k => by rw [hf]; positivity
  have hxhalf : (0 : ℝ) < x / 2 := by linarith
  have hfactor : besselJ1 x = (x / 2) * ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k := by
    unfold besselJ1; rw [← tsum_mul_left]; congr 1; ext k
    rw [hf, hy, pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]; ring
  have hfa : Antitone f := by
    apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le; intro k
    have hfac1 : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 1) * (k ! : ℝ) := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hfac2 : ((k + 2)! : ℝ) = ((k : ℝ) + 2) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ) := by
      rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ]; push_cast; ring
    have hkne : (k ! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero k)
    have hk1ne : ((k + 1)! : ℝ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (k + 1))
    have hstep : f (k + 1) = (y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2))) * f k := by
      show y ^ (k + 1) / (((k + 1)! : ℝ) * ((k + 2)! : ℝ))
        = (y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2))) * (y ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)))
      rw [hfac2, hfac1, pow_succ]; field_simp
    rw [hstep]
    have hc : y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2)) ≤ 1 := by
      rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]; nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k, hy2]
    calc (y / (((k : ℝ) + 1) * ((k : ℝ) + 2))) * f k ≤ 1 * f k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (hfnn k)
      _ = f k := one_mul _
  have hfs : Summable f := by
    have hcomp := Real.summable_pow_div_factorial y
    apply hcomp.of_nonneg_of_le hfnn
    intro k
    have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((k + 1)! : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero (k + 1))
    have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k ! : ℝ) := by positivity
    show y ^ k / ((k ! : ℝ) * ((k + 1)! : ℝ)) ≤ y ^ k / (k ! : ℝ)
    gcongr; nlinarith [hk1, hkpos]
  have hb := alternating_series_error_bound f hfa hfs 0
  simp only [Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, sub_zero] at hb
  have hf0 : f 0 = 1 := by simp [hf]
  rw [abs_le] at hb
  have hS : (∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k) ≤ 1 := by have h2 := hb.2; rwa [hf0] at h2
  rw [hfactor]
  calc (x / 2) * ∑' k, (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * f k ≤ (x / 2) * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hS (le_of_lt hxhalf)
    _ = x / 2 := mul_one _

name: besselJ0_even
text:
import RiemannLean.Bessel
open scoped Nat
/-- `J₀` is even: `J₀(-x) = J₀(x)` (each series term depends on `x` only through `(x/2)^{2k}`). -/
theorem besselJ0_even (x : ℝ) : besselJ0 (-x) = besselJ0 x := by
  unfold besselJ0
  congr 1; ext k
  rw [show (-x) / 2 = -(x / 2) by ring, (even_two_mul k).neg_pow]

name: rat_matrix_posSemidef
text:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
open Matrix
/-- Concept proof for the Lean-verified certificate bridge (LEDGER §755/§758): a concrete PSD
matrix with rational entries is machine-checked `PosSemidef` over ℝ (quadratic form = sum of
squares) — the Lean end of a rigorous finite Weil-positivity certificate. -/
theorem rat_matrix_posSemidef :
    (Matrix.of ![![(2 : ℝ), 1], ![1, 2]]).PosSemidef := by
  rw [posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
  · intro x
    simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons, star_trivial]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0 + x 1), sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]

name: ldlt_posSemidef
text:
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.PosDef
import Mathlib.Data.Real.StarOrdered
open Matrix
/-- **General LDL^T certificate** (the Arb→Lean lifting): any matrix `L · diag(d) · Lᴴ` with
`d ≥ 0` is `PosSemidef`.  An organ-2 rigorous Weil certificate is an exact-rational LDL^T
factorization `M = L·diag(d)·Lᴴ` with nonneg rational pivots `d`; this theorem turns ANY such
certificate into a machine-checked Lean proof of positive-semidefiniteness. -/
theorem ldlt_posSemidef {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    {d : n → ℝ} (hd : 0 ≤ d) (L : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (L * Matrix.diagonal d * Lᴴ).PosSemidef :=
  (Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal hd).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same L
